basic_details.job_title: NCC Gp HQ Prayagraj Associate NCC Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Permanent Assistant Professors and Professors of Allahabad University institutions can apply for the posts of Associate NCC Officers (ANOs) of the National Cadet Corps in the Senior Division under NCC Group Headquarters, Prayagraj Notification No 04/2026 dated 30 October 2026. Applications in Form-III go through the Head of the Institution to the respective NCC unit, and must reach NCC Group Headquarters, Prayagraj by 30 November 2026. Applications received after the due date will not be entertained.

age_limit.details: Candidates applying for Senior Division ANOs should not be below 21 years of age and should not be above 45 years of age as on 30 November 2026 (the last date of receipt of applications). The upper age limit is relaxable by a further 03 years, i.e. up to 48 years of age, at the sole discretion of the DG NCC. No further relaxation will be provided. For an age relaxation case, a Statement of Case (SOC) duly recommended by the CO of the unit, in quadruplicate, is to be submitted on 20 November 2026.

The vacancies are of the Boys & Girls (Mixed) Bn of the Senior Division and not of the Girls Unit/Bn, so both male and female candidates can apply. University of Allahabad and Ewing Christian College, Prayagraj
Post/offline – Form-III through Head of Institution and the respective NCC unit
30 Nov 2026 (last date of receipt at NCC Gp HQ)

content_sections.heading: About the Recruitment
content_sections.text: NCC Group Headquarters, NCC House, Chatham Lines, Prayagraj-211002 has issued this notification to hold its next Selection Board for filling up ANO vacancies in Allahabad University, Prayagraj institutions. The covering letter (No.001/A/ANO/Degree College/HQ, 30 Oct 2026) is addressed to 1 UP Naval Unit NCC, Prayagraj and 2 UP Arty Bty NCC, Prayagraj, which are asked to forward the notification to the Principals of the institutions listed in Appendix-A so that applications of all eligible candidates are sent in.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application is made on Form-III and does not go directly from the candidate to the Group Headquarters. The notice lays down this route: Fill in Form-III – only a typed copy is accepted. Write your pay scale clearly in red ink on the top right-hand corner of Form-III. Applications without the pay scale on Form-III will be rejected. Enclose all the certificates listed under Enclosures below. Get Part III of Form-III countersigned by the Registrar/Vice Chancellor of the concerned University, and get the application recommended by the Head of the Institution. Submit the application to the respective NCC unit before the last date of receipt of applications. The NCC unit scrutinises the applications and forwards them in one lot so that they reach NCC Group Headquarters, NCC House, Chatham Lines, Prayagraj-211002 before 30 November 2026. The Form-III format itself is not attached to this notice. The covering letter states that no application is to be withheld if it is in order and the candidate fulfils the requisite qualifications.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The posts are Associate NCC Officers (ANOs) of the National Cadet Corps in the Senior Division, in degree colleges under Allahabad University listed in Appendix-A. The vacancies are of the Boys & Girls (Mixed) Bn of the Senior Division and not of the Girls Unit/Bn, so both male and female candidates can apply. Vacancies of institutions other than those of this University Division/Wing are not to be considered. Permanent Asst Professors/Professors serving in an existing NCC institution/university, of the grade of Asst Professor/Professor etc., teaching students of graduation and above and a member of the permanent teaching staff, are eligible. A certificate to this effect from the Vice Chancellor/Registrar must be attached. The candidate's pay scale also determines whether he or she is eligible for the Senior Division. Citizen of India. Medically fit, with a certificate from the CMO/Medical Practitioner in the requisite column of the application form. Good moral character. Should not have been dismissed earlier from NCC, ITF, TA or the Armed Forces. Should not be a member of any communal/political organization. Candidates applying for Senior Division ANOs should not be below 21 years of age and should not be above 45 years of age as on 30 November 2026 (the last date of receipt of applications). The upper age limit is relaxable by a further 03 years, i.e. up to 48 years of age, at the sole discretion of the DG NCC. No further relaxation will be provided. For an age relaxation case, a Statement of Case (SOC) duly recommended by the CO of the unit, in quadruplicate, is to be submitted on 20 November 2026. The notice does not mention any pay or honorarium for the ANO appointment. The pay scale referred to in the notice is the candidate's existing pay scale as a teacher, which must be written on Form-III. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Certificate from the Vice Chancellor/Registrar that the candidate is a permanent teaching staff member of the grade of Asst Professor/Professor. Certified true copy (CTC) of the appointment letter in the Asst Professor/Professor grade. CTC of the High School certificate as proof of age. CTCs of the highest educational qualification certificate, professional certificate (if any), and current pay certificate including pay scale issued by the Principal/VC etc. Medical certificate in the format "To be completed by the Medical Officer", signed by the applicant and by a Govt Medical Officer or Registered Practitioner with seal; the medical must be done between the notification date and the last date of receipt of applications. Certificate that the SD ANO vacancy being subscribed is as per authorization, i.e. from an institution allotted an NCC Coy of not less than 50 cadets. Authentication Sheet as per format, attached with Form-III. Statement of Case in quadruplicate, recommended by the CO, Unit (age relaxation cases only). For "DC ANOs only": documents for grant of commission, to accompany Form-III for onward submission to HQ DG NCC under Rule 21 (5) & (6) Sub Para (a) & (b) and 18(5) & (6) Sub Para (a) & (b) of the NCC Act & Rules 1949 (GD). For Normal ANOs (other than DC), these documents continue to be dealt with as before.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates will be required to appear for an interview before a Selection Board to be held at the Vice Chancellor Office, Allahabad University, Prayagraj. The interview date is not specified in the notice. Selection for the Army, Navy and Air Wing is made by different Boards of Officers and is not clubbed in a single board proceeding. The selected candidates will have to undergo a Pre-Commission Course of 12 weeks duration. Candidates who have served in NCC earlier in the same Division, or who possess the 'C' certificate, will undergo a 12 weeks PRCN (DC) Course. The selection remains valid until the existing policies, issued from time to time, are revised. A selected candidate must complete the requisite course/appointment as ANO within the selection validity period; otherwise the selection is automatically treated as cancelled.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date for the NCC ANO application at Prayagraj?
faq.answer: Applications must reach NCC Group Headquarters, Prayagraj by 30 November 2026, forwarded by the respective NCC unit in one lot; late applications will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q2. Who can apply for the Associate NCC Officer (Senior Division) post?
faq.answer: Permanent Asst Professors/Professors serving in an existing NCC institution/university, teaching students of graduation and above, and members of the permanent teaching staff can apply, with a certificate from the Vice Chancellor/Registrar.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for NCC ANO Senior Division?
faq.answer: Candidates should not be below 21 years and not above 45 years of age as on 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any age relaxation?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is relaxable by a further 03 years, i.e. up to 48 years, at the sole discretion of the DG NCC, with a Statement of Case in quadruplicate recommended by the CO, Unit, submitted on 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the NCC ANO post?
faq.answer: Submit a typed Form-III, recommended by the Head of the Institution and with the required certificates, to the respective NCC unit, which forwards it to NCC Gp HQ Prayagraj before 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates appear for an interview before a Selection Board at the Vice Chancellor Office, Allahabad University, Prayagraj, and selected candidates then undergo a 12-week Pre-Commission Course.

faq.question: Q7. Can female teachers apply?
faq.answer: Yes. The vacancies are of the Boys & Girls (Mixed) Bn of the Senior Division, and both male and female candidates can apply.

faq.question: Q8. Which institutions have ANO vacancies?
faq.answer: Appendix-A lists the University of Allahabad, Prayagraj and Ewing Christian College, Prayagraj (1st Division NCC and 2nd Division NCC), all in the SD/SW Army wing.

faq.question: Q9. Why must the pay scale be written in red ink on Form-III?
faq.answer: The candidate's pay scale determines eligibility for the Senior Division, and applications whose pay scale is not written on Form-III will be rejected.
